title: Project Showcase
subtitle: A selection of projects, initiatives, and resources I've developed or led. Click an item for more details.

projects.title: Secondary School EdTech Audit & Strategic Plan Development
projects.description: Proactively initiated and led a comprehensive secondary school EdTech audit to establish a clear baseline. Conducted walkarounds, surveys, and interviews, then performed in-depth analysis (including SWOT for SLT). Collaborated with SLT, HODs, and IT to translate findings into actionable strategies, directly informing targeted PD focus, resource allocation, and tailored tech sessions for KS5 students, bringing strategic direction to school EdTech.
projects.technologies: Needs Assessment, Initiative & Leadership, Data Collection & Analysis (MS Forms), SWOT Analysis, Strategic Planning, Stakeholder Collaboration, Presentation Skills, Reporting

projects.title: Development of School AI Policy & Guidance Resources
projects.description: As Chair of the Whole School EdTech Committee (Primary & Secondary), led the identification of necessary policy amendments and facilitated the collaborative development of guidelines for responsible Generative AI use. Managed contributions from HODs and teachers, delegated tasks effectively, navigated scheduling challenges across sections, and presented the finalised framework to SLT. This provides clear boundaries, supporting safe student innovation and teacher confidence.
projects.technologies: Policy Development, Committee Leadership, Facilitation, Delegation, Stakeholder Management, AI in Education, Resource Creation, Presentation Skills

projects.title: Design & Management of EdTech Pathways PD Programme
projects.description: Implemented and managed the 'EdTech Pathways' PD programme, designing specific strands (AI, iPad, Kognity/OneNote) based on audit data and stakeholder consultation. Facilitated cohorts (2-12 staff each) through year-long development involving targeted sessions and collaborative tasks. Organised successful Learning Summits where staff showcased evolved practices and resources, demonstrably building school-wide EdTech capacity.
projects.technologies: PD Design & Facilitation, Programme Management, Needs Analysis, EdTech Coaching, Adult Learning, AI Tools, iPad Integration, Kognity, OneNote, Event Organisation

projects.title: KS4/5 Student Digital Organisation & Workflow Initiative
projects.description: Collaborated with HODs to address challenges with paper planners (loss, inconsistent use). Provided technology expertise to support the transition for KS4 and KS5 students to digital organisation using existing school platforms (Outlook Calendar, Teams). Developed and delivered student workshops and video guides, promoting effective task management, reminders, and digital planning skills, streamlining student workflows.
projects.technologies: Student Training, Digital Literacy, Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, Workflow Improvement, Collaboration, Video Guides

projects.title: Staff Hardware Evaluation & Procurement Recommendation
projects.description: Initiated and managed a rigorous trial of 2-in-1 devices (Surface Pro, Dell XPS) vs traditional laptops prior to a large-scale refresh (~80 devices). Conducted staff needs analysis (Primary/Secondary), defined evaluation criteria, systematically collected user feedback over 8 weeks (MS Forms), and liaised with SLT and IT. Presented the final data-driven recommendation *against* 2-in-1 adoption (due to battery/heat issues), successfully preventing investment in unsuitable hardware and protecting teacher workflow.
projects.technologies: Needs Analysis, Technology Evaluation, Pilot Project Management, Data Collection, Recommendation Reporting, Risk Mitigation, Stakeholder Collaboration

projects.title: Organisation & Delivery of Whole-Staff CPD Programmes
projects.description: Organised and coordinated three major whole-staff CPD events annually using a carousel format (4-5 choices per session). Selected relevant topics based on strategic goals, audit data, and staff surveys (e.g., AI, Trello, popular Excel basics). Managed all logistics (scheduling, comms, sign-ups) while also delivering sessions and actively empowering/supporting other tech-savvy teachers to lead sessions, fostering shared expertise and building overall staff capacity.
projects.technologies: PD Organisation, Logistics, Communication, Needs-Based Topics, Session Facilitation, Mentoring, MS Forms

projects.title: Departmental IWB Rollout & Change Management Facilitation
projects.description: Successfully managed the transition of the Mathematics department from legacy boards to new BenQ interactive displays. Overcame initial resistance by employing targeted change management strategies: detailed consultations, relationship building with HOD/staff, identifying Maths-specific use cases, providing tailored training, and intensive post-installation support. Facilitated collaboration between Maths, IT, and SLT. Resulted in positive adoption, effective use with iPads, and the department becoming an exemplar for others.
projects.technologies: Change Management, Stakeholder Relations, Needs Assessment, Training Design, Technical Support, Project Coordination, BenQ Displays, iPad Integration

projects.title: Creation & Curation of Staff Micro-Learning Video Resources
projects.description: Implemented and curated a 'Tech Tips' micro-learning initiative to address staff skill gaps identified via audit. Created over 50 short (<2 min) video tutorials on core school platforms (iSAMS, Outlook, Teams etc.) and timely workflows (e.g., gradebook shortcuts). Distributed weekly via staff briefings and maintained an organised online repository, providing accessible, just-in-time support and improving staff efficiency, receiving positive informal feedback.
projects.technologies: Video Production, Content Curation, Instructional Design, Micro-Learning, Needs Analysis, iSAMS, M365, Communication

projects.title: Redesign & Delivery of New Staff Technology Onboarding
projects.description: Redesigned and delivered the technology component of the new staff onboarding programme. Created fun, interactive sessions covering essential platforms (iSAMS, Outlook, Teams, CPOMS, OneNote). Successfully accelerated new hires' operational readiness and established a clear point of contact for ongoing EdTech support, receiving positive informal feedback on improved integration experience.
projects.technologies: Onboarding Design, Training Delivery, Interactive Learning, Platform Expertise, iSAMS, M365, CPOMS, EdTech Support

projects.title: Implementation & Facilitation of Student Tech Ambassador Programme
projects.description: Implemented the Student Tech Ambassador programme (Year 10) to leverage peer knowledge and develop student leadership. Recruited and mentored students, established group goals and weekly meetings. Guided ambassadors in planning and creating student-facing micro-learning videos (OS tips, OneNote, OneDrive, citation tools etc.) and providing basic tech support for new students, fostering digital skills across the student body.
projects.technologies: Programme Implementation, Student Leadership, Mentoring, Peer Education, Video Production Guidance, CapCut

projects.title: Academic Lead for SIS Integration Rollout (Salamander)
projects.description: Served as the Academic Lead for the rollout of the Salamander integration between iSAMS (SIS) and MS Teams/Outlook. Focused on user-side success: tested the integration extensively, liaised between academic staff and IT/regional teams to resolve issues, documented procedures, developed user guides, and managed user communication/training to ensure smooth adoption of automated timetable syncing and Team creation, improving long-term efficiency.
projects.technologies: System Integration Lead, UAT, IT Liaison, Troubleshooting, Documentation, Training, Change Management, iSAMS, MS Teams, Outlook
